raw_text: Review README.md and /src files; update overview. .NET 10.0 (`net10.0`); latest C#, nullable/implicit usings, warnings as errors. Central versions: [Directory.Packages.props](Directory.Packages.props); settings: [Directory.Build.props](Directory.Build.props). `dotnet format`. Never hardcode sensitive information in source code. Avoid logging sensitive information. Use HTTPS for all communications. Validate and sanitize all user inputs. Use parameterized queries or ORM features to prevent SQL injection. Use `xUnit` for all tests. Do not name test classes with "Tests" suffix; do use "Tests" suffix for folder names if needed. dotnet run --project src/YourProject/YourProject.csproj. Use DI, OWASP, guards/FluentValidation, DTOs, REPR/DDD, async I/O; production `src/`, tests `tests/`; AAA, Shouldly, NSubstitute; Markdown.
